summary: Backend + frontend testing for Campaigns redesign. Backend pytest suite: 5/6 passed. Frontend Playwright covered list stats/templates/plan-cards, LIVE toggle flip+restore, Sold editor (LIVE card, trigger card, mismatch banner, WHAT HAPPENS rows, timeline, people rows, duplicate/delete), preview toggle, touch editor (presets, tokens, quick links, send_card grid, thankyou card, note input), replies/delivery/trigger/rename sheets, full create->add-touch->save->reload persistence, template prefill+summary, and /workflows regression. All critical flows work; a few minor issues noted.

minor.issue: Older/legacy campaigns in list are missing the new fields ai_assist_mode and scope in the response (only sent_this_week is uniformly enriched). Review-request expects every item to carry ai_assist_mode + scope. Frontend renders defaults, but the get_campaigns handler should backfill these fields (e.g. ai_assist_mode default from ai_enabled, scope default 'personal') when the doc doesn't have them.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid 'touch-preset-Custom…' was not found in the DOM for the Sold campaign editor. Right-away and 1-week were both present. Either the Custom preset is not rendered for the current touch state, or the testid differs from the review-request spec.

Multiple React Native web console warnings: "Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>." repeatedly on both /campaigns/new and /campaigns/[id]. Indicates a stray string/space inside a <View> child list. Cosmetic only but pollutes console.

Delete plan uses the native browser confirm() (RN Alert on web) rather than an in-app testable dialog. There is no data-testid on the confirm button, so automated tests cannot confirm deletion; cleanup had to be done via backend DELETE. Consider a custom modal with dialog-confirm/dialog-cancel testids.

issues: Layout, badges, timeline dots and pills render cleanly at 430x932 with no text overflow observed on the first 4 plan cards
Gold Heads-up mismatch banner renders correctly; WHAT HAPPENS rows readable; timeline touch previews with tokens display fine

action_items: Backend: Backfill ai_assist_mode and scope defaults in GET /api/campaigns/{user_id} for legacy campaigns that don't have them stored (or run a one-time migration).
Frontend (optional): Verify touch-preset-Custom… testid is emitted (or update tests) and clean up the 'Unexpected text node' warnings in campaigns/new.tsx and campaigns/[id].tsx.
Frontend: Replace the native browser confirm on Delete Plan with a testable in-app modal (add data-testid on the Delete confirm button).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/campaigns.py get_campaigns (~line 619) enriches sent_this_week but does not normalize/backfill ai_assist_mode and scope on legacy docs; response schema is inconsistent across list items.
frontend campaigns delete confirmation uses non-testable native confirm - blocks automated cleanup and CI regression.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up two throwaway campaigns via API + one via UI (backend cleanup executed). Sold campaign 69d172b9276decacd8e16eaa left in LIVE state (restored after toggle test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_campaigns_redesign.py. The Sold campaign 69d172b9276decacd8e16eaa is seed data and was left unchanged (LIVE, 5 touches, 5 people). One legacy-doc backfill concern documented above. Delete confirmation uses native browser confirm - use Playwright's page.on('dialog') handler if you need to accept it in future tests.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical bugs. Legacy-field gap is due to get_campaigns only enriching sent_this_week; older campaigns pre-date the ai_assist_mode/scope fields and are returned as-stored.
